name: AttackBox · Live Watch
description: Live traffic, evidence forensics, and delivery health. Distinct-record counts; raw capture and contextual previews remain separate.

rawConfiguration.text:
# Live watch
**5-minute pulse · 15-minute trends.** Fixed windows on this page. Counts use first chunks and distinct record IDs; they describe retained evidence, not all incoming traffic. Filter by `sensor_id` / `deployment_id` for one campaign. A blank value is missing data, not proof of health.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000) AS 'Retained requests' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND direction = 'request' AND action != 'capture' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 SINCE 5 minutes ago

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT uniqueCount(session_id, precision: 10000) AS 'Sessions seen' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND direction = 'request' AND action != 'capture' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 SINCE 5 minutes ago

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT uniqueCount(src_ip, precision: 10000) AS 'Source IPs' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND direction = 'request' AND action != 'capture' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 SINCE 5 minutes ago

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT (aggregationendtime() - latest(timestamp)) / 1000 AS 'Age · seconds' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'shipper' FACET hostname SINCE 5 minutes ago LIMIT 5

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT rate(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), 1 minute) AS 'Requests/min' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND direction = 'request' AND action != 'capture' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT rate(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), 1 minute) AS 'Requests/min' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND direction = 'request' AND action != 'capture' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET status TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 10

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT rate(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), 1 minute) AS 'Requests/min' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND direction = 'request' AND action != 'capture' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET persona TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 5

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT percentile(export_lag_ms / 1000, 50, 95) AS 'Event to attempt · seconds' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 AND export_lag_ms IS NOT NULL TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(queue_backlog_bytes) / 1048576 AS 'Unacknowledged MiB' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'shipper' FACET hostname TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 5

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Arrived', latest(request_id) AS 'Request', latest(src_ip) AS 'Source', latest(persona) AS 'Persona', latest(resource) AS 'Route', latest(body_chunk) AS 'Redacted first chunk', latest(request_complete) AS 'Request body complete', latest(capture_reason) AS 'Capture reason' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND action = 'request_received' AND direction = 'request_start' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET record_id SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 25

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(ship_queue_dropped_total) AS 'Cumulative queue drops' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'shipper' FACET hostname TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 5

rawConfiguration.text:
## Who is here?
Sources are observed addresses, not identities. Sessions are bait correlations. Select a row or add a dashboard filter before opening **Evidence & Forensics**.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000) AS 'Requests', uniqueCount(session_id) AS 'Sessions', latest(persona) AS 'Latest persona', latest(timestamp) AS 'Last seen' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND direction = 'request' AND action != 'capture' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET src_ip SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 15

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000) AS 'Requests', latest(src_ip) AS 'Source', latest(persona) AS 'Persona', latest(resource) AS 'Latest route', latest(timestamp) AS 'Last seen' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND direction = 'request' AND action != 'capture' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 AND session_id IS NOT NULL FACET session_id SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 15

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000) AS 'Decisions' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'probe' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 AND action = 'decision' FACET probe_id SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 12

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000) AS 'Records with attributed follow-up', latest(session_id) AS 'Latest session', latest(timestamp) AS 'Last seen' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'probe' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 AND followup IS NOT NULL FACET followup SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 12

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(bait_connected) AS 'Bait connected', latest(last_bait_record_age_ms) / 1000 AS 'Bait silence · s', latest(queue_backlog_bytes) / 1048576 AS 'Queue · MiB', latest(errors_total) AS 'Client errors · cumulative', latest(lost_total) AS 'Client losses · cumulative', latest(ship_queue_dropped_total) AS 'Queue drops · cumulative' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'shipper' FACET hostname, deployment_id SINCE 5 minutes ago LIMIT 20

rawConfiguration.text: **Interpretation:** follow-ups are reported attribution, not proof of execution or compromise. Export lag ends at an attempt; it excludes vendor indexing delay. Counters reset on restart. Host JSON and observations are strings, not nested query fields. No data may mean quiet traffic, missing collection, failed export, or a filter mismatch.

pages.name: Evidence & Forensics
pages.description: Redacted context, raw capture manifests and segments, host evidence and provenance.

rawConfiguration.text:
# Evidence & Forensics
Filter by `deployment_id`, `request_id`, `session_id`, or `src_ip`. This page follows the dashboard time picker (queries default to 15 minutes). **Redacted previews are context. Base64 capture records are raw, untrusted evidence.** Do not execute decoded content. Table limits are not a complete export.

widgets.title: Redacted request / response previews · chunk identity

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Time', latest(request_id) AS 'Request', latest(session_id) AS 'Session', latest(src_ip) AS 'Source', latest(direction) AS 'Direction', latest(resource) AS 'Route', latest(status) AS 'Status', latest(body_chunk) AS 'Redacted preview', latest(chunk_count) AS 'Chunks' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND action != 'capture' AND record_id IS NOT NULL FACET record_id, body_sha256, chunk_index SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 50

widgets.title: Probe attribution and observations · serialized JSON

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Time', latest(session_id) AS 'Session', latest(probe_id) AS 'Probe', latest(followup) AS 'Attributed follow-up', latest(observations) AS 'Observations JSON', latest(delivery) AS 'Probe delivery' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'probe' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET record_id SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 25

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Time', latest(hostname) AS 'Host', latest(event) AS 'Bounded host JSON', latest(attrs_truncated) AS 'Attributes cut' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'runtime' AND stream = 'runtime' AND action = 'falco' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET record_id SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 25

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Time', latest(hostname) AS 'Host', latest(event) AS 'Bounded source JSON', latest(attrs_truncated) AS 'Attributes cut' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'egress' AND stream = 'egress' AND action = 'egress_blocked' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET record_id SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 25

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(schema_version) AS 'Schema', latest(boot) AS 'Producer boot', latest(source) AS 'Role', latest(ingest_ts) AS 'Host intake · ms', latest(persona_version) AS 'Persona version', latest(policy_version) AS 'Policy version', latest(redaction_version) AS 'Redaction version', latest(fp_epoch) AS 'Fingerprint epoch', latest(fp_scope) AS 'Fingerprint scope' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET sensor_id, deployment_id SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 20

rawConfiguration.text:
## Raw capture coverage
Join capture records by request and evidence kind. Sort decoded segments by offset only after deduplicating record/body-hash/chunk identity. `evidence_complete` describes producer capture; it does not prove every segment arrived. Manifest and segment/hash verification are required outside this bounded preview.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Time', latest(request_id) AS 'Request', latest(evidence_target) AS 'Target kind', latest(evidence_complete) AS 'Producer complete', latest(evidence_segments) AS 'Expected segments', latest(evidence_reason) AS 'Completion reason', latest(evidence_bytes) AS 'Capture bytes', latest(evidence_sha256) AS 'Capture SHA-256' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND action = 'capture' AND evidence_encoding = 'base64' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND evidence_kind = 'manifest' AND chunk_index = 0 FACET record_id SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 30

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(request_id) AS 'Request', latest(evidence_kind) AS 'Kind', latest(evidence_segment) AS 'Segment', latest(evidence_offset) AS 'Byte offset', latest(evidence_bytes) AS 'Bytes', latest(evidence_sha256) AS 'Evidence SHA-256', latest(chunk_count) AS 'Chunks', latest(body_chunk) AS 'Untrusted base64' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND action = 'capture' AND evidence_encoding = 'base64' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND evidence_kind != 'manifest' FACET record_id, body_sha256, chunk_index SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 30

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT filter(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), WHERE evidence_complete = true) AS 'Complete claimed', filter(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), WHERE evidence_complete = false) AS 'Incomplete claimed' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream = 'edge' AND action = 'capture' AND evidence_encoding = 'base64' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND evidence_kind = 'manifest' AND chunk_index = 0 FACET evidence_target SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Host evidence rate · retained records per minute

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT rate(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), 1 minute) AS 'Records/min' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 AND source IN ('runtime', 'egress') FACET source TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago

pages.name: Telemetry Health
pages.description: Producer liveness, durable backlog, export attempts, losses and backend errors.

rawConfiguration.text:
# Telemetry Health
**Follow the delivery chain:** producer → host intake → durable queue → export attempt → New Relic query. A live shipper heartbeat bypasses the queue. Healthy heartbeat plus growing backlog is not healthy evidence delivery. Fixed 5/15-minute windows on this page; counters are cumulative within a process lifetime.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE bait_connected = true) AS 'Heartbeat reports connected · %' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'shipper' SINCE 5 minutes ago

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(queue_backlog_bytes) / 1048576 AS 'Unacknowledged MiB' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'shipper' FACET hostname SINCE 5 minutes ago LIMIT 5

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(last_bait_record_age_ms) / 1000 AS 'Since host received bait record' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'shipper' AND last_bait_record_age_ms >= 0 FACET hostname SINCE 5 minutes ago LIMIT 5

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT percentile(export_lag_ms / 1000, 95) AS 'Event to export attempt' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 AND export_lag_ms IS NOT NULL SINCE 5 minutes ago

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT rate(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), 1 minute) AS 'Queried records/min' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET source TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 5

widgets.title: NR client errors and losses · process lifetime

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(errors_total) AS 'Client errors', latest(lost_total) AS 'Client losses' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'shipper' FACET hostname TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 5

widgets.title: Shipper heartbeat snapshots · latest by host

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Last heartbeat', latest(bait_connected) AS 'Bait connected', latest(last_bait_record_age_ms) AS 'Bait age · ms (-1: never)', latest(spool_clients) AS 'Bait socket clients', latest(queue_backlog_bytes) AS 'Queue bytes', latest(ship_queue_dropped_total) AS 'Queue drops · cumulative', latest(dropped_total) AS 'NR client queue drops', latest(lost_total) AS 'NR client losses' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'shipper' FACET hostname, deployment_id SINCE 5 minutes ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Bait memory spool · bytes and records

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(queue_bytes) AS 'Queued bytes', latest(queue_len) AS 'Queued records', latest(dropped_total) AS 'Drops', latest(errors_total) AS 'Socket errors', latest(reconnects) AS 'Reconnects', latest(timestamp) AS 'Last heartbeat' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'bait' FACET hostname, boot SINCE 5 minutes ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Host intake delay · producer clock dependent

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT percentile((ingest_ts - timestamp) / 1000, 50, 95) AS 'Producer to host · seconds' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 AND ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND timestamp_clamped IS NULL TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago

widgets.title: Capture or admission truncation flags · distinct records

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT filter(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), WHERE body_truncated = true) AS 'Body truncated', filter(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), WHERE attrs_truncated = true) AS 'Attributes truncated', filter(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), WHERE fields_truncated = true) AS 'Fields truncated', filter(uniqueCount(record_id, precision: 10000), WHERE timestamp_clamped = true) AS 'Timestamp clamped' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET source SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 5

FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Event time', latest(ingest_ts) AS 'Host intake · ms', latest(export_attempt_at_ms) AS 'Export attempt · ms', latest(export_lag_ms) / 1000 AS 'Latest attempt lag · s', latest(record_id) AS 'Latest record' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND record_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index = 0 FACET source, deployment_id SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 20
FROM NrIntegrationError SELECT timestamp, message, newRelicFeature SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 100

widgets.title: Durable queue loss by role · process lifetime

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log, Log_AttackEvidence, Log_Security, Log_Operations SELECT latest(ship_dropped_bait_total) AS 'Bait queue drops', latest(ship_dropped_runtime_total) AS 'Runtime queue drops', latest(ship_dropped_egress_total) AS 'Egress queue drops' WHERE `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat' AND source = 'shipper' FACET hostname TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 15 minutes ago LIMIT 5

rawConfiguration.text: **Counter limits:** queue drops are separate from client errors/losses and bait memory-spool drops. Counters reset on restart. Query times use event timestamps, so very delayed records may fall outside this live window; expand time on **Evidence & Forensics**. Export lag is event-to-attempt time, not backend indexing time. No error rows is not proof of acceptance; verify known canaries. Integration errors are account-wide.
